SEOBNR_ODE.name: SEOBNR_ODE
SEOBNR_ODE.notes: Experimental EOB waveform with continuous attachment based on a natural cubic spline through accepted integration samples. The selected interior peak is locally differentiable, with piecewise interval selection. Auxiliary resampling-spacing invariance does not establish integration-step convergence or full-waveform accuracy. The frozen LAL catalog case did not pass.

primary_references.citation: Bohé et al. (2017), Phys. Rev. D 95, 044028

standalone: published complex 22 mode and phase components
published final mass and signed final-spin fits
experimental_components.remaining: Complete waveform agreement and integration-resolution convergence remain to be established. Continuous attachment is a component improvement, not a complete EOB accuracy result.

SEOBNRv4Published.flux_modes: 35 positive-m modes through ell=8, with symmetry-paired flux
SEOBNRv4Published.conventions: Initial orbital phase zero; phic rotates h22 by exp(-2i*phic); tc sets NQC amplitude peak; finite Fourier sum uses exp(-2*pi*i*f*t). No taper. Target phase/time compatibility unresolved.
SEOBNRv4Published.numerical_limits: Discrete peak/stencil/sample-count selection; local quartic matching and linear earlier interpolation. Float64 preferred; finer step checks required. Two-input convergence is not a 1e-6 accuracy certificate.
SEOBNRv4Published.scope: Explicit experimental assembly; does not replace SEOBNR_ODE or certify SEOBNRv4/ROM. Required choices were frozen before binary probing.
